Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::createLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemId and
		o.Content = content),
		isExists: Boolean = loanTerm.oclIsUndefined()
	precondition:
		if loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() 
		then LoanTerm.allInstance()->excludes(loanTerm) 
		endif 
	postcondition:
		if isExists 
		then let newLoanTerm: LoanTerm in
		newLoanTerm.oclIsNew() and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newLoanTerm) 
		else result = isExists 
		endif 
}
